sources.check: Forge Boss agent files (e.g. build-boss.md's `memory: project`) use a real Claude Code subagent frontmatter field named `memory` with scope values user/project/local.
A subagent frontmatter `isolation: worktree` field runs that subagent's Bash/PowerShell commands inside an isolated git worktree branched from the default branch.
Subagent frontmatter supports a `hooks:` field for lifecycle hooks scoped to that ONE subagent, distinct from project-level settings.json hooks.
The subagent frontmatter `model:` field accepts the routing aliases sonnet/opus/haiku/fable (matching FORGE_MODEL_ROUTING.json's alias set) in addition to a full model ID or `inherit`.
The native `/goal <condition>` command keeps Claude working across turns until an owner-set completion condition is met.
check_tokens: keeps working across turns until the condition is met

sources.check: The native `/loop <interval>` command plus cron scheduling tools can run prompts repeatedly, poll for status, or set one-time reminders within a session.
check_tokens: cron scheduling tools to run prompts repeatedly

sources.check: The n8n Webhook node exposes a configurable Authentication option and a configurable Respond behavior that forge-n8n's validation gate ('webhook auth enabled') depends on.
HOOKS_OPT_IN.md documents PreToolUse/PostToolUse as real Claude Code hook event names.

The PreCompact hook event supports matcher values `manual` and `auto`, with a stdin payload carrying session_id/transcript_path/cwd/hook_event_name/compaction_type — the exact contract forge-snapshot-marker.cjs reads.
